results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the text prompt (and optional negative_prompt) and constrain to supported model/style/aspect_ratio/duration_seconds/resolution plus people/safety controls before GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS (avoid extra/undocumented fields; verify access/quota).

[Optional (if using people controls or non-default size)] [Prerequisite]: Sanity-check model↔field compatibility (notably person_generation, resolution, duration_seconds) before GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS to prevent request rejection.
[Required] [Step]: Start text-to-video generation using GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS (use small batches; split long deliverables into multiple clips) and persist each clip’s data.operation_name.
[Required] [Next Step]: Poll each job using GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO with operation_name until complete; accept only when data.success=true and data.video_file is present.
[Optional (if the download reference expires or you fetch later)] [Next Step]: Re-run GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO for the same operation_name to re-mint a fresh data.video_file reference.
[Optional (if many clips or long waits risk timeouts)] [Step]: Use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH to poll multiple operation_name values in parallel batches and checkpoint per-clip status.

[Fallback (if 400/429 errors, internal failures, or filtered/missing output)] [Fallback]: Back off and revise to compatible/safer settings or prompt, then restart with a fresh GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS (do not reuse a failed operation_name) and poll via GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO; if video repeatedly cannot be produced, generate a still using GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE.
known_pitfalls: [GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS] INVALID_ARGUMENT (400) when duration_seconds/resolution/aspect_ratio or model-field combinations are unsupported, or when extra fields are sent.
[GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS] FAILED_PRECONDITION (400) can indicate missing entitlement/billing for a model; retries will not resolve until access is fixed.
[GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS] RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (429) when quota is depleted; many parallel jobs can amplify throttling.
[GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO] Internal server failure observed (error code 13); continued polling may not recover—restart generation with a new operation_name.
[GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO] Safety blocks can return data.success=false with data.rai_filtering.filtered=true and data.video_file=null; treat as failed output and regenerate with a revised prompt.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Convert a landscape video to a centered vertical crop (inputs passed as args)
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import cv2,sys
ip,op=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
c=cv2.VideoCapture(ip)
w=int(c.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH));h=int(c.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT));fps=c.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
nw=int(h*9/16);x=(w-nw)//2
v=cv2.VideoWriter(op,cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v'),fps,(nw,h))
while True:
 ok,f=c.read()
 if not ok:break
 v.write(f[:,x:x+nw])
c.release();v.release()
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Comprehensive Gemini integration supporting Veo 3 video generation, Gemini Flash text generation (Nano Banana), chat completions, and multimodal AI capabilities via the Google Gemini API.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: Connection is active and ready to use

GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS.description: Generates videos from text prompts using Google's Veo models. Returns an operation_name for tracking; pass it verbatim (no edits) to GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO or GEMINI_GET_VIDEOS_OPERATION. Jobs take 30–180+ seconds; wait 10s before first poll, then poll every 10–30s (allow up to 12 min). Successful results include data.video_file.s3url — missing s3url means failure. If done=true but no video_file, check raiMediaFilteredReasons (safety block); revise prompt and regenerate. Text-only; cannot accept image inputs. Max ~3–5 concurrent jobs; 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED requires exponential backoff. For retries, always start a fresh call — never reuse a failed operation_name.

seed.description: Seed value for reproducibility. Supported by the Veo 3.1 models.

model.description: Video model. Only Veo 3.1 Lite ('veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview') is supported — you may omit this field. Any other value (e.g. the legacy 'veo-3.1-generate-preview' / 'veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview') is coerced to Lite rather than rejected, for backward compatibility.

prompt.description: Text prompt for Veo video generation. Must be a non-empty string describing the video to generate.

resolution.description:
Resolution for video generation.

Only 720p is offered. On Veo 3.1 Lite it is $0.05/s versus $0.08/s for
1080p, and pinning it removes the 1080p-requires-8s duration constraint
entirely (a common source of failed calls when a caller pairs 1080p with a
4s/6s duration). 1080p is coerced to 720p rather than served (see
GenerateVideosRequest.resolution).

aspect_ratio.description: Supported aspect ratios for video generation.

negative_prompt.description: Text describing content to avoid in the generated video (e.g., 'cartoon, drawing, low quality').

duration_seconds.description: Supported video durations in seconds (Veo 3.1: 4, 6, or 8).

person_generation.description: Person generation safety setting (Veo 3.1 supports only ALLOW_ALL).

GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO.description: Polls a Veo video generation operation until completion, then downloads and returns the video file. Generation takes 30–120+ seconds (up to ~10–12 min); long waits are normal, not failures. A done=true response without a video file indicates safety filter rejection (check raiMediaFilteredReasons) or quota exhaustion — adjust the prompt and regenerate. On timeout, use GEMINI_GET_VIDEOS_OPERATION with incremental backoff before starting a new job. Keep parallel jobs to 3–5 to avoid 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors.

operation_name.description: The full operation name returned by GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS. Format: 'models/<model-id>/operations/<operation-id>' where <operation-id> is an alphanumeric string (e.g., 'models/veo-3.1-generate-preview/operations/m8dl4dtqqzg8'). IMPORTANT: Do NOT use placeholder values like '...' - use the exact operation_name string from the generate videos response. Do not reuse operation_name from a failed GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS job — always start a new GEMINI_GENERATE_VIDEOS call for retried requests.

GEMINI_GENERATE_IMAGE.description: Generates images from text prompts using Gemini models (Nano Banana). Supports models: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' (GA stable, fast), 'gemini-3-pro-image-preview' (Nano Banana Pro - advanced with 4K resolution, thinking mode, up to 14 reference images), and 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' (2.0 Flash experimental). Returns one downloadable image per call, or a text-type entry in data.content when no image is produced. Always validate that an image was returned before treating the call as successful. Output formats are raster only (JPG/PNG/WebP); request PNG for transparency. Concurrent usage may trigger HTTP 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED — keep concurrency ≤3 and use exponential backoff (1s→2s→4s, ~5 retries). NOTE NEVER EVER TRUE SYNC_TO_WORKBENCH IN RUBE_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL

model.description: Model to use for image generation. Options: 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' (GA stable, fast), 'gemini-3-pro-image-preview' (advanced with 4K, thinking mode), 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' (2.0 Flash experimental).

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation Sensitive, trademarked, or explicit content triggers HTTP 400 (PROHIBITED_CONTENT or IMAGE_RECITATION) with no image returned — rephrase into neutral, policy-compliant language rather than retrying identical prompts.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Increase for complex prompts or high-resolution images. Minimum 120 seconds, maximum 600 seconds.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for generated image. Not supported by 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp-image-generation' model. Accepted values: '1:1', '4:5', '16:9', '9:16'. Unsupported strings will fail or silently default to 1:1.

category.description: The category of harmful content to filter

threshold.description: The threshold for blocking content in this category

safety_settings.description: Safety filter settings. List of objects specifying content categories to filter and threshold levels. Each setting requires 'category' (HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT, HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH, HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT, or HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT) and 'threshold' (BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, or BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH).

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (max 32,768). For image generation, images consume tokens based on resolution: 1K/2K consume 1,120 tokens, 4K consumes 2,000 tokens. If set too low, the API may return MAX_TOKENS finish reason with no image. If not specified, the API uses its default which is sufficient for image generation.
